title: Cute Toddler Riding New Tricycle, 1957 Home B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century domestic snapshot showing a toddler seated proudly atop a brand new metal tricycle inside a home living room. An adult, likely the father, stands behind in suspenders and trousers. The print features classic 1950s deckled edges and an original developer date stamp '57' in the right margin, reflecting the post-WWII baby boom era of domestic comfort and simple family milestones.
